# REFMAR (SHOM) recorded answer

`brest-2026-11-08.json`: the last 30 minutes of the raw measures (`sources=1`) of the tide gauge of Brest (REFMAR 3), as
`https://services.data.shom.fr/maregraphie/observation/json/3` answered on 2026-11-08 (Licence Ouverte 2.0, SHOM). Used by
`tests/test_live_feeds_tool.py` to replay the weekly check without the network.
